scope: Rust only; synthetic H264/AAC 640x360 15fps; recording off; 16 viewers; 20 seconds per mode; A-B-B-A; Edge and WSL on same workstation

components.decision: Excluded from per-viewer RTC send path after end-to-end comparison; microbenchmark only.

limitations: Component timings are not whole-service gains or maximum viewer capacity.
Initial candidate WebRTC CPU increased; final variant restores per-viewer audio copy. No whole-service speedup versus v0.6.0 established.
MSE FPS and browser drops varied; two runs per build do not establish a statistically reliable service speedup.
GPU execution was not tested because no NVIDIA GPU is installed.

soak.build_note: Soak, storage and ONVIF used the initial candidate. Final code differs only by restoring the existing RTC per-viewer audio copy; 60s copy variants and final decoded audio tests verify that send path.
